description: Derive a new task plan from a Git change set -- the staged changes (or, with `--unstaged`, the unstaged and untracked changes, with `--branch`, a branch against its base, or, with `--commit`, a single commit) -- optionally narrowed to a scope topic, by filling its SPECIFICATION (WHAT), DESIGN (HOW), and VERIFICATION (WHEN) sections (or only the focused ones), so that a re-implementation of the task, e.g. after an export to a foreign issue tracker, yields a similar change set. Use when the user wants a change set, branch, or commit "turned into", "described as", or "reverse-engineered into" a "task", "plan", or "issue".
